triggers.name: trg_athlete_custom_sessions_delete
triggers.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER trg_athlete_custom_sessions_delete
        AFTER DELETE ON 'athlete_custom_sessions'
        WHEN (SELECT active FROM sync_flag WHERE id = 1) = 0
        BEGIN
          INSERT INTO sync_tombstones (table_name, remote_key, deleted_at)
          VALUES ('athlete_custom_sessions', COALESCE(OLD.remote_id, cast(OLD.id as text)), strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now'));
        END

triggers.name: trg_athlete_custom_sessions_insert
triggers.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER trg_athlete_custom_sessions_insert
        AFTER INSERT ON 'athlete_custom_sessions'
        WHEN (SELECT active FROM sync_flag WHERE id = 1) = 0 AND (NEW.dirty IS NULL OR NEW.dirty != 1)
        BEGIN
          UPDATE 'athlete_custom_sessions'
          SET dirty = 1, updated_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now')
          WHERE rowid = NEW.rowid;
        END
